matrix.current_source: App Core challenge uses GET /api/experience/runtime/identity with HTTP Basic; separate account login/logout uses POST /v4/auth/login and POST /v4/auth/logout (Bearer). Existing Core session lookup resolves the account session; SSO and live App-to-Core acceptance remain unverified.

Flutter reads GET /api/settings/subjects?domain_id=CTH through subject_registry.get_subjects(); it requires the existing account Bearer session and CTH subject_registry/read domain Permission. GET /api/experience/subjects remains a separate legacy route and is not used by the App. Registry rows are selection metadata only.

Flutter CoreAcc03Repository.load() calls LumenisCoreClient.runtimeIdentity() -> GET /api/experience/runtime/identity, then settingsContext() -> GET /api/settings/context. It does not call /api/experience/screen/ACC-03; the separate lazy-merged legacy experience_screens._build_acc03() is not this Flutter call path. Runtime identity is operational process/database state; settings context is context-selection data.

Flutter CoreAcc04Repository.load() calls screen('ACC-04') -> GET /api/experience/screen/ACC-04. experience_runtime._all_builders() lazily merges experience_screens.SCREEN_BUILDERS, including _build_acc04() -> legacy _envelope(source='runtime', bound=true, sections=...) with no guard object. Flutter Acc04Snapshot.fromResponse marks guard available only when source='runtime', bound=true, and guard is a map; the legacy bound flag alone does not satisfy this typed guard contract.
experience_runtime._build_cth01() → database.get_stats() and daily_reporting.generate_today_summary(); external footfall/sales sources are absent.
experience_runtime._build_cth01() → database.get_events(); recent CTH event rows are present.
experience_runtime._build_cth01() → daily_reporting.generate_today_summary() and current daily risk summary.

experience_screens._build_cth02() remains a mapped aggregate source for current scope/category/note counts but Flutter does not call it. CTH-02 currently reads GET /api/settings/subjects?domain_id=CTH for selection-only Subject metadata; Subject → unit → brand/format relations remain NOT_COLLECTED.
experience_screens._build_cth03() returns exact-scope Canonical rows with source_url plus verified row projection/Evidence integrity; Flutter Cth03Record currently drops the SourceTarget fields.
experience_screens._build_cth04() → curated event records; requested relationship-graph edges are not supplied.
experience_screens._build_cth05() → current daily data source for the calendar; source read errors can be converted to zero.
experience_screens._build_cth06() → negative/high-risk note source; actual row fields differ from the declared high-risk-item contract.
experience_screens._build_cth07() → database.get_stats_by_date_range(); the declared get_metric_trend callable is not used.
experience_screens._build_cth08() → high-risk notes/events; no canonical Case ID, state, or lifecycle source is present.
experience_screens._build_cth09() → risk note/summary; NOTE:<id> is not an Evidence record and the declared Evidence query is not called.

CoreCth09Repository.load reads settingsContext and screen CTH-09. Existing api_dual_domain.BusinessDecisionWorkflow.prepare/advance/reopen/save_result is exposed by lumenis_app_api /api/experience/business-works. The CTH-09 screen-to-business-work decision action binding has not been verified; reuse these owners, not a new Decision implementation.
experience_screens._build_cth10() reads the latest daily report and queries the shared Evidence store without product/Subject/origin filtering.
experience_screens._build_bmp01() → api_dual_domain.get_zbmp_product_snapshot(), filtered by product_id=ZBMP and domain_id=zbmp; BrandFocus-specific analytics remain blocked.
experience_screens._build_bmp02() → web_discovery.get_brand_directory(); curated directory/category data exists, not per-brand health/voice/engagement.
experience_screens._build_bmp03() reads admitted intelligence_assets FACT/VERIFIED aggregates without product/domain/brand filtering.
experience_screens._build_bmp04() → brand_propagation.get_all_dashboards()/list_entities() without BrandFocus; engine construction can initialize schema and errors can look like zero.
experience_screens._build_bmp05() → kos_engine.get_stats()/list_profiles(); profiles are not filtered by brand and omit content/conversion/Evidence refs.
experience_screens._build_bmp06() → content_generation.list_evidence() with defaults; no product/domain scope and source errors may collapse to empty.
experience_screens._build_bmp07() → topic_campaign.get_campaign_rate_status() for process quota/cooldown only; no read-only campaign activity list exists.
experience_screens._build_bmp08() → podcast_store.get_stats()/list_entities(); no brand filter, Evidence IDs are dropped, and reads can initialize schema.
experience_screens._build_bmp09() → evaluation summary/records without actor/domain/brand filters; builder drops evidence_ref and imports may initialize tables.
experience_screens._build_bmp10() reuses CTH Subject-based curated events/risk notes; this is not BMP BrandFocus risk.
experience_screens._build_bmp11() → kos_intel.competitor_benchmark() uses configured terms/global note scores, not selected BrandFocus.
POST /api/experience/ai/intent → experience_runtime.ai_intent() and the canonical Skill Execution chain; the App composer remains disabled without trusted product context.
experience_runtime._build_ai01() → _provider_runtime(_ai_governance()); live state is available for named model providers only, not full health/latency.
experience_screens._build_ai02() → task timeline/execution history; current query returns global executions, not orchestration controls.
No verified persistent conversation thread/turn store or streaming callable was found; execution history is not a conversation API.
experience_screens._build_ai03() queries global Evidence; _evidence_items() supplies generic hard-coded lineage rather than joining Evidence to an execution.
experience_screens._build_ai04() reads function_registry.FUNCTION_MAP; canonical SkillRegistry.list_all()/stats() is already available in lumenis/shared/agents/skills/registry.py.
experience_screens._build_ai05() → AI governance/provider status; no full provider readiness acceptance.
experience_screens._build_sys01() → runtime_guardian.legacy_health_check() for health, Worker/DLQ and guardrail summary.
experience_screens._build_sys02() → collector_status_api.get_all_status(); registered collector health/status exists.
experience_screens._build_sys03() → canonical_data.self_check()/get_schema_versions() for database and schema checks.
experience_screens._build_sys04() reads PermissionLevel/OperationType enums; its archive action declaration is not a Permission decision API.
Flutter/browser local preference storage only; no backend preference endpoint or synchronized setting owner was verified.
Existing Browser Surface APIs and browser_surface.capability_report()/browser_surface_api routes provide capability/session data.
experience_screens._build_sys07() → ai_governance.get_owasp_security_status()/get_skills_light_status().
experience_screens._build_sys08() → logger.get_log_summary() for sanitized filename/count summary.
GET /api/experience/shared-skills provides the existing skill catalog; safe shared skill execution owner exists, but no scoped Studio draft/workspace contract was verified.
No dedicated selected-context pattern retrieval corpus/query was verified; catalog metadata is not scoped retrieval.
No Fact Wall claim resolver was found that verifies each claim against Evidence or a supplied brief; content detail output can echo input.
Publish approval-request route exists and records a human approval request; no actual external publish callable is verified.
POST /api/experience/ai/intent provides a one-shot AI call; no persistent SH thread/turn store or stream route was verified.
GET /api/experience/shared-skills returns implementation/binding/evaluation catalog metadata; registered does not mean ready or healthy.
experience_screens._build_sh02() → evidence_store.query_evidence()/get_stats() with global unscoped list/total.
experience_screens._build_sh03() → canonical_data.count_canonical() global table aggregates.
experience_screens._build_sh04() → report_engine.list_domain_reports() read-only catalog; export EFFECT route remains gated/unfinished.
experience_screens._build_sh05() → lumenis.shared.learning.collector.get_learning_history(); records exist globally without actor/domain scope.
experience_screens._build_sh06() → TaskEngine list_tasks()/get_dlq()/health_check(); queue/task state is global.
